svg.title: Kea Energy test design, automation and evidence
svg.desc: 12 features and 173 test points: 172 automated test points produce 412 automated test cases. Local commands and a parameterized Jenkins pipeline share the managed runner. Playwright, JUnit and Allure retain execution evidence; one manual test point requires human answer-quality review, which remains pending. Coverage counts are not passing results.
